# .opencode — AI configuration (canonical source of truth)

`AGENTS.md` at the repo root is the entry point (auto-loaded by OpenCode). Everything under
`.opencode/` is canonical; the only legitimate hand-edits happen here.

## Layout

- `rules/rules.md` — always-on invariants (`trigger: always_on`), the stack of record and the closing gate.
- `skills/**` — domain skills: `owasp` (always-on, + `STACK.md`), `backend-php` (+ `SKILL-ARCHITECTURE.md`),
  `frontend` (+ `SKILL-ARCHITECTURE.md`), `SSD`, `PRINCIPLES`.
  Canonical names are lowercase where the mirror is SCREAMING_CASE — the map lives in
  `scripts/ai-config-sync.mjs` (`SKILL_NAME_MAP`): `backend-php` → `BACKEND-PHP`,
  `frontend` → `FRONTEND`, `owasp` → `OWASP`; `SSD` and `PRINCIPLES` keep their names everywhere.
  The global mirror keeps the canonical lowercase names.
- `commands/*.md` — slash commands (`/backend-new-crud`, `/backend-new`, `/review`, …).

## Sync — never hand-edit a mirror

| Command                      | Direction                                                       | Writes                                                                                                                        |
| ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `npm run syn`                | `.opencode/{rules,skills,commands}` + `AGENTS.md` → mirrors     | `.claude/` and `.cursor/`; `rules.md` is mirrored as `rules.mdc`; `AGENTS.md` → `CLAUDE.md`; orphaned mirror files are pruned |
| `npm run syn:check`          | verify only                                                     | exits 1 on drift — part of `npm run verify`                                                                                   |
| `npm run syn:opencode`       | `.opencode/rules` + `.opencode/skills` → global opencode config | `~/.config/opencode/` (override with `OPENCODE_CONFIG_DIR`)                                                                   |
| `npm run syn:opencode:check` | verify only                                                     | exits 1 on drift                                                                                                              |

Protected paths are never pruned: `.claude/agents/`, `.claude/projects/`, `.claude/plugins/`,
`.claude/settings.json`, `.claude/settings.local.json`, `.cursor/mcp.json`,
`.cursor/project-facts.json`, `.cursor/README.md` — see `PROTECTED` in `scripts/ai-config-sync.mjs`.
